channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Blast kills teenager, injures dozens in northern Israel
item.description: A 15-year-old was killed and around 20 people injured when unexploded ordnance detonated in northern Israel.

item.title: Deadly gold mine air strikes highlight Egypt-Sudan border insecurity
item.description: Deadly air raids on gold miners in Sudan expose deepening border lawlessness and regional instability.

item.title: Oil tanker reportedly attacked in Strait of Hormuz region
item.description: Plumes of black smoke rise from a Petro Dolphin oil tanker by a drone attack off the coast of Oman.

item.title: Iran-Saudi talks on Yemen’s Houthis: What’s in it for Tehran?
item.description: Tehran seeks dialogue in Yemen conflict, warning a military solution risks complicating the volatile regional situation.

item.title: Iran sets crosshairs on ‘US-UAE’ oil shuttle out of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The IRGC is hitting more ships allegedly part of a shuttle operation to move crude oil beyond the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Why are the Houthis striking Saudi airports?
item.description: The attacks mark the deadliest assault on Saudi soil in more than a decade.

item.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
item.description: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

item.title: Mourners killed by Kenya police at ex-PM's national farewell not part of violence, BBC finds
item.description: After analysing 1,500 videos and images of the Raila Odinga memorial, Africa Eye finds that those killed were far from the scuffles.

item.title: Riyadh airport attacks another dangerous moment in already tense conflict
item.description: While the physical damage from Houthi attacks can be quickly repaired, the Saudi reputation for stability is taking a battering.

item.title: Why is it so hard to fight the Houthis?
item.description: Security correspondent Frank Gardner explains how the Iran-backed Houthis' precision strikes and guerrilla tactics have made it difficult for Saudi forces to gain the upper hand.
